title: REQ · BootScene plays the matching character animation on playAnimation
summary: playAnimation {target,name} plays the target character's idle or interact animation
description: Context: createCharacter in BootScene.ts (L105-L128) builds sprites but keeps no id lookup, and create() (L63-L85) never subscribes to reactToPhaser. Desired behavior: on playAnimation, find the character by id and play the resolved animation; interact returns to idle on completion. Unknown targets or names are ignored.
acceptance_criteria: Given target 'boy' and name 'interact', when playAnimation is emitted, then sprite.play is called with the interact key
Given target 'boy' and name 'idle', when emitted, then sprite.play is called with the idle key
Given an unknown target id, when emitted, then no play call occurs and nothing throws
